title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation combines parametric language models with retrieved external evidence. Grounding generation in retrieved documents can improve factuality and knowledge-intensive task performance.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
abstract: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions so a language model can gather information and adapt its plan. The approach links deliberate reasoning with external tool use.

title: Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation
abstract: Hallucination describes generated content that is unsupported by the provided source or real-world knowledge. Verification and grounding are common strategies for reducing unsupported generation.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
abstract: Sentence-BERT produces semantically meaningful sentence embeddings that can be compared efficiently. These embeddings support semantic search and similarity-based filtering.

title: Blackboard Architecture for Control
abstract: A blackboard architecture coordinates heterogeneous knowledge sources through a shared data structure. Components contribute opportunistically without requiring direct peer-to-peer invocation.
